snippet.title: Potato Simulator - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Potato Simulator, a physics-based platformer developed by Potato Dev. Players will control a potato through challenging obstacles in one piece. Leap over wide distances, avoid getting sliced, and keep a level head through it all. Potato Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).
